text: Add a dark mode / night theme
Lock screen widget showing current temperature
Pollen and allergy forecast
Extend the hourly forecast to 48 hours instead of 24
Smartwatch app (Wear OS / Apple Watch)
Notify me shortly before rain starts at my location
More wind speed units: knots, m/s, Beaufort
Air quality breakdown by pollutant (PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2)
Reorder saved locations by drag and drop
Moon phases and moonrise / moonset times
One-time purchase to remove ads permanently
Historical weather data, compare with past years
Show severe weather warning areas on the map
Support Indian regional languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi)
Daily morning forecast summary notification
What-to-wear / clothing recommendations based on weather
Golden hour and blue hour times for photographers
Offline mode: keep the last downloaded forecast available without internet
Customisable home screen: choose and reorder which cards are shown
UV index alerts when UV is high
Marine forecast: tides, wave height, surf conditions
Larger text size option for accessibility
Ski / snow forecast with snowfall and snow depth
Share the forecast as an image
Live lightning strike map
Radar controls: pause, animation speed, future radar frames
Show dew point
Cyclone / hurricane tracker with predicted path
Notify me when the rain has stopped
More home screen widget sizes (small 1x1 / 2x1, 4x1, large 5-day)
Air quality alerts when AQI gets unhealthy
Longer daily forecast (14-15 days)
